efficiency.flops_note: Convolution-only estimate, 2 FLOPs/MAC; excludes normalization, interpolation, activations and attention products.
efficiency.timing_scope: model only, float32, warmed up and synchronized

environment.reproducibility_note: Fixed seeds do not guarantee bit-identical results across devices.

efficiency.inclusive_timing_note: Includes image, semantic/instance-mask loading, preprocessing, forward pass and prediction transfer; excludes writing predictions and metrics.

empty_policy: Both empty: Dice/IoU=1, HD=0. One empty: HD=inf; report infinite counts separately. Undefined precision/recall are NaN, not silently zero.
distance_units: pixels at 384x384 letterboxed network resolution; not millimetres
annotation_provenance: Original FracAtlas fracture polygons; no student bone annotations used in the binary study.
